objective: Register a bounded, manual-only DR24 light-curve payload probe on the default branch so the source-backed probe can be dispatched against the dedicated investigation branch.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The probe implementation and deterministic contract tests are maintained in PR #255.
GitHub Actions exposes workflow_dispatch for a workflow only when its workflow definition is present on the repository default branch.
Pull-request-triggered probe runs do not retrieve external DR24 payloads.
CPVS exact-membership discrepancy remains unresolved and is not in scope for this workflow registration.

baseline.description: The DR24 payload probe workflow file is absent from main; the implementation exists on the PR #255 investigation branch.

expected_improvement: Expose a manual workflow_dispatch entry for the bounded DR24 probe.
Allow selecting the PR #255 investigation branch when dispatching the probe.
Keep source retrieval limited to a maximum of five explicitly supplied OIDs and read-only repository permissions.

reliability.before: The workflow definition was absent from the default branch, so manual dispatch was unavailable.
reliability.after: The workflow definition is present on the PR branch; manual dispatch availability remains unverified until merge.

scientific_validity.reason: No workflow_dispatch run has retrieved live DR24 payload data. Registration does not establish scientific validity.

measurement.trade_off: A separate workflow registration change is required before dispatch. This change does not modify scientific code, benchmark data, model artifacts, or acceptance criteria.

evidence: PR checks must validate the workflow and cumulative lifecycle record.
After merge, manually dispatch against the PR #255 branch and inspect the generated manifest and payload artifact.

root_causes: The workflow_dispatch definition was not present on the repository default branch; pull_request events did not trigger the source-backed payload-probe job.

findings: A successful pull-request contract test is not evidence of external DR24 retrieval.
Workflow registration must be validated separately from live payload retrieval.

open_blockers: PR checks must pass on the accepted head.
A workflow_dispatch run must retrieve the bounded OID sample and produce inspectable artifacts.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not promote DR24 payload availability to scientific benchmark truth without provenance and content validation.
Keep the CPVS discrepancy as an explicit scientific validation blocker.
